BiblicalUsage: The word is the Aramaic banquet, and it appears once, when the queen came into the banquet house at Belshazzar's feast, where the king had drunk wine from the vessels of the temple.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the banquet is the setting of the judgment: they feasted with God's vessels, and the writing was already on the wall.
